description: Direct-response copywriting skill. Use whenever persuasive marketing copy is being written, rewritten, or audited — sales pages, landing pages, email sequences, ad copy, VSL scripts, hooks and headlines. Operates in five modes (write / rewrite / audit / hook / teach), selects the right framework (PAS, AIDA, PASTOR, BAB, 4Ps) for the job, demands the required inputs before drafting, and delivers copy with the strategic reasoning attached.
